name: AppSignal
description: AppSignal lets agents search error incidents and stack traces, find slow actions and traces, read logs, metrics, check-ins and uptime monitors, and build dashboards. Each user signs in to their own AppSignal account through the browser. The sign-in gives all read and write tools, so agents can also change the state, severity and assignee of an incident and add notes.

prompts.text: Which new errors did my production app get since the last deploy?
Which actions were the slowest this week, and why?
Did any uptime monitor or check-in fail in the last 24 hours?

apps.name: AppSignal
apps.description: Error incidents, performance, logs, metrics and dashboards, over AppSignal's MCP server with browser sign-in.
